_comment: Performance baseline for the CI REGRESSION gate (plan 6.2). Re-based 2026-08-14 for the shared windows-latest runner: dev-machine numbers (2026-08-11) are 3-5x faster than CI under Defender, so a dev-tuned baseline always failed the relative check on green code. Values here are CI-runner budgets with headroom; absolute catastrophe gates live in the bench binaries. Metrics below 5 ms are exempt from the relative check: their absolute GATE (SLA < X ms) already fails the bench, and relative comparison on sub-5 ms values is pure noise.
